falsifiable_hypothesis: A fairly co-optimized own-drug affine interpolation control can beat the bandwidth-0.7 incumbent on the complete same-budget development task.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across the two separately costed 64-well orientations; never average predictions

method_summary: For every outer training split, exhaustively select native two-dose and three-dose own-drug interpolation subsets and one shared affine-calibration penalty using only three-fold inner patient-held losses, assign exactly sixteen third-dose upgrades, refit on the outer training patients, and score the untouched outer patients under two separately costed 64-well orientations.
